nom: Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin E Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report it hydrates without a greasy or oily film, and some use it as a lightweight daily moisturizer that offers mild oil control.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some with very dry skin, report strong hydration and a silky, plumped feeling, though one reviewer felt it wasn't quite enough on its own for dry/very dry skin and needed frequent reapplication.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-acne-prone, report it balances their skin and helps fade hyperpigmentation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or on retinoids, report it soothes and reduces redness without irritation, though the formula contains essential oils that a couple of reviewers flag as a possible concern for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin reports it absorbs fast, feels smooth, and hydrates well, though they had no dark spots to judge its brightening claims against.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes it as a good moisturizer/mask for mature combination skin, leaving skin hydrated, plumper, and glowing.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report the mask helps with skin elasticity and improves the look of wrinkles and other aging signs with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly describe the mask as deeply hydrating, leaving skin soft, plump, and dewy overnight; a couple of reviewers with dry skin felt it needed reapplication or a heavier moisturizer on top to be enough on its own.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with rosacea, report the mask reduces redness and calms burning sensations with regular use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer notes the niacinamide in the formula helps support the skin barrier alongside its brightening effect.
concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers, often pairing the mask with a vitamin C serum, report it helps fade hyperpigmentation, sun spots, and acne scars.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone skin generally report the mask does not cause breakouts and some say it helps clear acne marks and speeds healing, though results vary by individual.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the mask hydrates without adding grease and offers some oil control, leaving pores looking less visible.

aspects.libelle: Distinctive jelly or pudding-like texture that melts into skin
Included spatula is impractical to use
A little goes a long way, strong value
Contains fragrance and essential oils some find unwanted
Doubles well as daily moisturizer or overnight mask

extraits.texte: It's not the best for dry/very dry skin, doesn't moisturize enough, and it's sticky (clings to dry patches rather than moisturize). It has a very strong fragrance of lemon grass (No one has brought it up!) However the jelly consistency is fun to breakdown. If you have dry skin, you'd need to reapply after 20 minutes, it is a gel consistency so I'm sure everyone who has oily/normal skin would enjoy this.

I keep all my products in a mini fridge, applying this and all my Klairs product cold is pure luxuriousness! I have rosacea and I've tried so many products and Rx Medications…. This has helped my skin feel normal and reduce the redness and burning on my face.

A very hydrating leave on/sleep mask to reduce hyperpigmentation. It's best used after using Vitamin C as Vitamin E enhances the effects of Vit C. This has a very unique texture, almost like a jello. It jiggles initially but upon rubbing it into skin it turns into a light gel and absorbs into the skin quickly leaving behind a satin finish. I have oily skin and I love it because it doesn't leave any oily or greasy film. Within 3 months of use, I have noticed a significant reduction in my hyperpigmentation.

This is my first time trying this mask and "wow" it absorbs incredibly well. Containing Vitamin E, Niacinamide & Adenosine this mask is so soothing and moisturizing. I like the lightweight cool gel like consistency and this mask makes my skin look more radiant and smoother. I have been using this mask overnight and it has helped to balance & even out my combination skin as well as it fades hyperpigmentation. This can be used as an overnight mask or a moisturizer and as an added bonus it boosts the effects of Vitamin C.

This mask which also can be used as a moisturizer is Fortified with antioxidant Vitamin E, the E Mask brightens, improves wrinkles and prevents other signs of aging. The pudding-like texture is in memory foam consistency to reveal brighter, firmer and more hydrated skin, It has a thick jelly-like consistency. I used it with the freshly juiced vitamin drops. In terms of brightness it did help with it whilst also having hydrating effects. This product does contain essential oils which might not be suitable for sensitive skin. I prefer using this at night with the vitamin drops

I got this in a sample pack and I'm back to order the full size. I've had extremely dry skin this past winter and have been struggling. I've been putting this on my skin after washing it. I feel hydrated and smooth. It makes my face feel like silk. I absolutely LOVE the texture of this product - it's very interesting.
